classifications.rationale: The President immediately establishes an investigative board, sets its membership structure and qualifications, and reserves appointment of its members; these are internal organizational actions rather than changes to private legal rights.
classifications.evidence: There is established, effective July 15, 1986, a board of three members to be appointed by the President to investigate the disputes.

classifications.rationale: The provision directs how the board must conduct its functions by limiting operations to available funding; it is internal administrative management and does not itself release or mandate funding.
classifications.evidence: The board shall perform its functions subject to the availability of funds.

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines internal directions requiring the board to report and terminate with a presently operative legal prohibition barring carriers and employees from changing disputed conditions during the specified period.
classifications.evidence: no change, except by agreement of the parties, shall be made by the carriers or the employees in the conditions out of which the disputes arose
